title: Iambic Pentameter — Examples from Shakespeare
skills: identify iambic feet in poetic lines
scan lines for stressed and unstressed syllable patterns
analyze how Shakespeare uses meter for rhythm, emphasis, and meaning
alignment_note: Introduces iambic pentameter through examples from Shakespeare and demonstrates how patterns of unstressed and stressed syllables create meter. Supports scansion, poetry and drama analysis, prosody, oral reading, and interpretation of rhythmic choices across high school English courses.
